dialog: Well/ let's see how this goes.
Maybe I can win if I strike first.
I was never much of a fighter.
I don't like to stand out...
Always fight back when someone attacks you.\n　That's the fairy way.
I should be able to strike back. Let's see...
I'm one of the weakest fairies around.\n　Do I get points for not giving up?
I can see you perfectly!
I help too/ sometimes!
This comes natural to us.
Time to test our special attack.
Here goes!
Weee!
Incoming!
There!
I hope this hits!
I know exactly where you are!
I'll just shoot in your general direction!
I can sense anything that moves.
It's hard to dodge when I spread them out like this/ don't you think?
Girls/ give me a hand.
Let's do this/ Luna/ Star!
Alright!
Working together's our thing.
Ready? Now!
Please take it from here/ girls.
What do you mean/ take it from here"?\n　This won't work without you/ Star!
Yeah. It's three-or-nothing.
Oh/ I guess that's true.\n　Well/ let's do it/ then.
Gotcha. Now!
Since we're here/ we might as well use our formation.
Sure. Star/ you do the honors.
Very well. I have to say the line/ right?
That's right. Honestly/ I figured you'd hate that.
I don't mind that much—\n　...Oh. Sorry/ that's all the time we get.
Together/ we can do anything!
Okay Star/ you be the leader this time.
We'll attack at the count of three.
I'll count. One/ two...
Three!
Together/ we can do anything!
Okay Star/ you be the leader this time.
We'll attack at the count of three.
I'll count. One/ two...
Hiyaah!!
Together/ we can do anything!
Okay Star/ you be the leader again!
We'll attack at the count of three.
Very well.\n　One-two-three-go!
Huh?\n　Hey/ wait up!
Time to work together/ girls.
The L Formation Attack/ right?
Yes. Let's show them what the Three Fairies of Light are made of!
Count us down/ Sunny.
Okay! Three/ two/ one... Go!
Let's get in formation.
Ready to fire whenever you are.
We've been practicing every day for this!
Counting down. Three/ two/ one...
Light 'em up!
Let's do that/ girls.
That?\n　Oh/ you mean that"!
You want to show them how close we are/ right?
You got it. We'll follow your lead/ Sunny.
Gotcha. Here goes!\n　Ka-BLOOM!
Together/ we can do anything!
Okay/ let's go for our usual formation.
Sure thing. Have fun/ girls.
Staaar! You have to join/ too!
I know/ I know. Hyaaah!!
What if I just kept running and left altogether?
I can sense your presence/ you know?
What if I just kept running and left altogether?
Whoops. I didn't mean to use you as a shield.
There's the enemy!
There's more where that came from!
I guess I have to put in some effort once in a while.
Sure. Use the weak fairy as a shield.
I'll stay here and try to annoy them!
I love staying back. It's safe/ and it looks like I'm doing something.
They shouldn't be coming my way/ which is perfect.
They're approaching from that direction.\n　Better be careful!
I suggest we shoot that way and see how it goes.
I suppose I might as well fire some danmaku.
This is the perfect time to strike!
I'll assist you with my star powers!
Strike while the stars shine bright!
They got Sunny?!\n　I won't stand for this!
Mind if I jump in/ Sunny?
I'll follow your lead/ Sunny!
Oh/ Sunny. You're always so reckless.
Sunny! Are you okay?!
If I were the lead/ we'd probably take it easier...
Sunny/ it's time to show what we fairies are made of.
Sunny/ use your power well!
Sunny/ I found the enemy!
Sunny/ I sense a presence over there!
Go for it/ Sunny!
Come on Sunny/ you can do it!
The stars are always there to support the Sun!
This is as good as it gets! Now/ Sunny!
Together/ we are like one!
I'm so sorry/ Luna!
Mind if I jump in/ Luna?
With Luna's ability to mute sound/ I can sneak in and attack!
Oh/ Luna. You're always so careless.
Lunaaa! You're such a klutz!\n　...Wait/ isn't this Sunny's job?
If I were the lead/ we'd probably take it easier...
I think even the two of us could win this one/ Luna.
Luna/ use your power well!
I wonder if the two of us are actually making a difference.
Let's go/ Luna!
Luna/ I found the enemy!
Come on/ Luna/ you can do it!
The stars are there to support the moon!
This is as good as it gets! Now/ Luna!
Together/ we are like one!
I'm sorry/ Rumia!
Mind if I jump in/ Rumia?
Right behind you/ Rumia!
Oh/ Rumia. You're always so reckless.
Rumia! Are you okay?
Rumia/ I found the enemy!
Go for it/ Rumia!
Come on Rumia/ you can do it!
This is as good as it gets! Now/ Rumia!
I suppose I might as well fire some danmaku.
The stars are on your side/ Rumia!
Rumia's on a roll. I'll go with the flow!
Rumia! We fight together as one!
I'm so sorry/ Dai!
Initiating FFC—Feeble Fairy Combination!\n　...Just kidding.
I'm right behind you/ Dai!
Oh/ Dai... It's alright/ I'll help you.
Are you okay/ Dai?
Dai/ I found the enemy!
Let's do our best/ Dai!
Hopefully between the two of us we manage to hit something.
This is as good as it gets! Now/ Dai!
I suppose I might as well fire some danmaku.
The stars are on your side/ Dai!
Dai's on a roll. I'll go with the flow!
Dai! We fight together as one!
I'm sorry/ Cirno!
Mind if I jump in/ Cirno?
I'm right behind you/ Cirno!
Oh/ Cirno. You're always so reckless.
Cirno/ you okay?
Cirno/ I found the enemy!
Come on Cirno/ you can do it!
Cirno/ it's time to show what we fairies are made of.
This is as good as it gets! Now/ Cirno!
I suppose I might as well fire some danmaku.
The stars are on your side/ Cirno!
Cirno's on a roll. I'll go with the flow!
Cirno! We fight together as one!
M-Marisa?! Th-This can't be real!
Initiating FFC—Feeble Fairy Combination!\n　...Just kidding.
Mind if I help/ Alice?
I suppose I can help a shrine maiden once in a while.
The stars and the moon are always a good match!
I think some starlight would go well with your concert!
Allow me to help/ Lunasa!
Careful now. I don't want to mess up the performance.
I'll set the stage! Give this story a happy ending!
Allow me to help/ Merlin!
Is she going to sample these sounds too?
Allow me to assist/ Lyrica!
Let us combine our stellar powers!
Hey! That hurts!
Eeek!
I'll report you for fairy abuse!
I couldn't dodge it!
Why me?!
Owww! Would you stop that?!
That won't do.
I can't take it easy this time/ can I?
How about you give up and go home instead?
I can sense anything that moves. Anything.
Could you please attack someone else now?
This is not my first danmaku battle/ you know.
Heheheh. I think I'll put on some tea.
I knew exactly where you were coming from.
Seeing things coming is kind of my thing.
They got meee!
Th-This shouldn't have happened...
Well/ I guess I worked hard enough for today.
Well/ there you have it.\n　If you need me/ I'll be in the back/ having some tea.
Dai/ how about we go sit in a corner and just wait this out?
I'm ready to fight/ Dai.
Rumia/ how about we go sit in a corner and just wait this out?
I'm ready to fight/ Rumia.
Cirno/ how about we go sit in a corner and just wait this out?
I'm ready to fight/ Cirno.
I can't believe I'm actually trying to fight a god...
I know it won't amount to much/ but I'd regret forever not even trying.
You never learn/ do you?
I have to admit/ it IS a pretty good prank.
You never learn/ do you?
I have to admit/ it IS a pretty good prank.
